info.bio:
There are two artists with this name. 1) Funk/disco band from London, UK. 2) Synthwave artist from Germany.

1) Heatwave was an international funk/disco musical band featuring Americans Johnnie Wilder, Jr. and Keith Wilder (vocals) of Dayton, Ohio, Englishman Rod Temperton (keyboards), Swiss Mario Mantese (bass), Czechoslovakian Ernest "Bilbo" Berger (drums), Jamaican Eric Johns (guitar) and Londoner Roy Carter, (guitar).

scenes.name: Las bandas soul y los «supergrupos»
scenes.book: Funk: The Music, the People, and the Rhythm of the One
scenes.author: Rickey Vincent
scenes.desc: Tras EWF, Rufus y los Commodores las discográficas querían bandas: la «banda soul», versión blanda de la banda funk, unidades completas que podían soltar un groove monstruoso pero se producían como grupos pop. Los Brothers Johnson, descubiertos por Quincy Jones (el bajo de Louis Johnson), triunfaron con Look Out for #1 y Right on Time; Blam! (1978) fue su último funk antes del disco-pop de Lite Up the Nite. Heatwave, sexteto multirracial de Alemania con Rod Temperton y los Wilder de Dayton; L.T.D. con Jeffrey Osborne; Frankie Beverly y Maze (de Filadelfia a California, apadrinados por Marvin Gaye), cinco discos de oro de funk suave; Rose Royce, el vehículo de Norman Whitfield (Car Wash). Off the Wall (1979) de Michael Jackson unió con Quincy Jones, Temperton y Louis Johnson todos los elementos de moda sin perder el groove. Bill Berry los llamó en Ebony (1978) «supergrupos»: espectáculos de estadio de fervor casi religioso, como las giras Earth de P-Funk que lanzaron a Cameo, Slave, Rick James y Bootsy. En 1980 casi todos se habían deshecho o pasado al pop.

podcast.title: Dayton, Ohio Roots & Disco Boom
podcast.body: Heatwave, co-founded by brothers Johnny and Keith Wilder from Dayton, Ohio, is recognized as originating from the "birthplace of funk." Keyboardist and writer Rod Temperton, though British, was considered the "spirit of the band" by Questlove and was instrumental in writing major hits for Michael Jackson. Temperton openly stated that Heatwave played a significant role in the European disco boom. "Johnny Wilder and his brother Keith Wilder were from Dayton and were co-founders of the band."

podcast.title: Rod Temperton's Songwriting Success
podcast.body: Rod Temperton, the British keyboardist and writer for Heatwave, was described by Questlove as "the spirit of the band." Beyond Heatwave, Temperton achieved significant recognition for writing several iconic songs for Michael Jackson, including "Off the Wall," "Rock with You," and "Thriller." "You might know some of the other songs he wrote off the wall, rock with you and thriller by one Michael Jackson."
